dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Real battles are the foundation of military training. Fights against powerful foes are necessary!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Opponents?

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: That's right! There are many types of foe...

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Charge forward during missions and take the lead in fighting bandits. Treat them as your opponents and use all your abilities against them.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: During drills, I fight against Sergeant Lin with real weapons as if I'm fighting a real opponent, practicing to fight against enemy leaders...

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Of course, the Sergeant has at least ten more years of training than me, so I usually get knocked down, but he's always careful not to hurt me.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: You can also have friendly spars with the hired guards during break time to hone your hand-to-hand combat skills.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Those will definitely come in handy when you're fighting at close range and can't use your spear.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: In short, fighting against different opponents will teach you how to fight in different environments.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is your normal training not enough?

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: No, no, no. Our routine training covers dozens of different items, such as basic marksmanship, defensive formation basics, moving in offensive formation, and more...

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: There's nothing to complain about in terms of variety. Unfortunately, the target audience of the training is the majority. That is to say, ordinary soldiers.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: You'll need to find other ways if you want to become stronger after learning and mastering everything taught by this training.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: My goal in life is to defeat monsters like Xuanwen Beasts alone, but I have yet to receive Rex Lapis's approval and don't have a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Therefore, I can only keep honing my martial arts and challenging my physical limits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great point! Talk to you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Thanks for the recognition. If you have a chance, why don't we have a friendly spar next time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, the strength of a Xuanwen Beast...

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: That's difficult to quantify.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: Just like how some people are completely hopeless at martial arts and some are talented geniuses, there are large weak men and slender youths who have extraordinary sword skills...

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: I'm sure some Xuanwen Beasts might be extremely weak to the point that even poorly-equipped hired guards can manage them.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: We currently have very little information about the strongest Xuanwen Beasts.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: I'm just estimating here, albeit assuming that they're on the stronger side... But a single paw swipe may be equal to a direct hit from the Guizhong Ballista.

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: *sigh* Can a mortal really block such a mighty blow?

dialogues.speaker: Keshen
dialogues.text: ...No, I can't let this discourage me. I need to train harder!
